youtube_short.description: Your most-used apps were deliberately built to confuse you into spending money — and the average smartphone user loses $840 a year because of it. It's called dark patterns, and 95% of top apps use at least one. We break down the three worst: the free trial that auto-upgrades when you can't find the cancel button, confirm shaming buttons that guilt you into subscribing, and impossible unsubscribe flows that take five clicks plus a phone call. The EU banned all three in 2023. Tonight, open your bank statement and find every subscription you didn't mean to sign up for. #darkpatterns #personalfinance #moneytips #finance #appscam
